analysis_plan.rule: Frozen existing-warmup upper-median offsets; missing phase uses zero; no rule changes after results
analysis_plan.primary_cost: sum(raw Krylov iterations) + rho_common * actual rebuild count over the common physical window
analysis_plan.rho_common: Upper median of the pooled raw setup/(solve_time/iterations) observations from the old and new online run in the same round
analysis_plan.comparison: Reprice every archived fixed-period run at the same round's rho_common, select the minimum total cost in the archived K grid, and divide each online cost by it
analysis_plan.supplementary: Also report per-solve cost ratios, since some old Tosi paper tables used per-solve averages and solver counts can differ
analysis_plan.wallclock: New/old solver-region and external-wall ratios within each concurrent pair; median across 3 ASPECT rounds / 5 MOOSE rounds; no historical fixed wall times compared
analysis_plan.fixed_sources: Existing official-input archived results; MOOSE counts corrected to actual Krylov iterations verified against CSV and KSPGMRESOrthog
analysis_plan.resources: At most 12 solver processes; estimated memory sum 19.4 GiB; each actual process guarded at 7 GiB, cgroup at 40 GiB, each probe at 25 minutes
analysis_plan.Elmer: Not modified: the generic variable NonlinIter is updated through convergence machinery; correspondence to current FlowSolve local iter at IterSolve entry has not been validated, requiring a separate Fortran port and call-order audit
